post.title: [Hiring] Next.js marketing site with a headless CMS
post.body: Looking for a developer to build our marketing site in Next.js with Sanity as the CMS. About 8 pages, a blog, and a contact form. Design is done in Figma. Happy to talk about price once I see who is interested.

analysis.summary: Build an 8-page Next.js marketing site with a Sanity CMS, blog and contact form from finished Figma designs. Budget not stated.
